envelope.description: Add the sc5 seam types (TaskImplementerRequest / Report / Adapter)

body.title: Add the sc5 seam types (TaskImplementerRequest / Report / Adapter)
body.summary: Add the three sc5 interfaces to schemas.ts: TaskImplementerRequest (task bound to the WORKFLOW PlanTask at src/workflow/artifacts/plan.ts — NOT the same-named analyze-types interface — plus storyDesignMarkdown, planMarkdown, completedDependencies: readonly BuildTaskOutcome[], repoRoot, and the bounded maxAttempts repair budget), the deliberately two-field advisory TaskImplementerReport ({ claimedComplete, narrative }), and the TaskImplementerAdapter interface with a single implement(req): Promise<TaskImplementerReport>. Types only, no implementation (migration step 3).
acceptanceChecks: schemas.ts exports TaskImplementerRequest, TaskImplementerReport ({ claimedComplete, narrative }), and TaskImplementerAdapter with one method implement(req: TaskImplementerRequest): Promise<TaskImplementerReport>.

TaskImplementerRequest.task is typed against the WORKFLOW PlanTask from src/workflow/artifacts/plan.ts and completedDependencies is readonly BuildTaskOutcome[]; the report is documented and used as advisory-only.

tests.name: schemas: TaskImplementerRequest.task binds to the WORKFLOW PlanTask (src/workflow/artifacts/plan.ts) with completedDependencies typed readonly BuildTaskOutcome[], and TaskImplementerReport exposes only the two advisory fields { claimedComplete, narrative }
